The aroma of the mushrooms tickles your nose as you peel back the leafy wrapping.|Cooking (Interface)|AoC}} ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== Mushroom Rice Balls can be made by [[Cooking]] any [[Mushroom]] together with [[Hylian Rice]]. The regular version can be made either by using [[Hylian Shroom]]s, which have no status effects, or by using multiple Mushrooms with differing effects. When eaten, they will restore some of [[Link]]'s [[Heart]]s. The scent of Mushrooms tickles one's nose as they peel back the leafy wrappings of this [[Meal]]. By using certain Mushrooms, the following variations of Mushroom Rice Balls can be made: * '''Chilly Mushroom Rice Balls''':{{Cite|{{Big|Chilly Mushroom Rice Balls}}
Grants low-level heat resistance.
The aroma of the mushrooms tickles your nose as you peel back the leafy wrapping.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by using [[Chillshroom]]s or other chilly Ingredients. These rice balls can be eaten to grant Link one level of [[Heat Resistance]]. * '''Electro Mushroom Rice Balls''':{{Cite|{{Big|Electro Mushroom Rice Balls}}
Grants low-level electricity resistance.
The aroma of the mushrooms tickles your nose as you peel back the leafy wrapping.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by using [[Zapshroom]]s or other electric Ingredients. They grant Link one level of [[Shock Resistance]] when eaten. * '''Enduring Mushroom Rice Balls''':{{Cite|{{Big|Enduring Mushroom Rice Balls}}
Restores and overfills your Stamina Wheel.
The aroma of the mushrooms tickles your nose as you peel back the leafy wrapping.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by using [[Endura Shroom]]s or other enduring Ingredients. These meals will completely refill and overfill Link's [[Stamina Wheel]]. * '''Energizing Mushroom Rice Balls''':{{Cite|{{Big|Energizing Mushroom Rice Balls}}
Instantly refills some of your Stamina Wheel.
The aroma of the mushrooms tickles your nose as you peel back the leafy wrapping.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by using [[Stamella Shroom]]s or other energizing Ingredients. Link's Stamina Wheel will be partially restored by eating these. * '''Hasty Mushroom Rice Balls''':{{Cite|{{Big|Hasty Mushroom Rice Balls}}
Grants a low-level movement-speed boost.
The aroma of the mushrooms tickles your nose as you peel back the leafy wrapping.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by using [[Rushroom]]s or other hasty Ingredients. Consuming them will increase Link's speed. * '''Hearty Mushroom Rice Balls''':{{Cite|{{Big|Hearty Mushroom Rice Balls}}
Restores your health and temporarily increases your maximum hearts.
The aroma of the mushrooms tickles your nose as you peel back the leafy wrapping.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by using [[Hearty Truffle]]s, [[Big Hearty Truffle]]s, or other hearty Ingredients. Eating these rice balls will heal all of Link's Hearts and grant him temporary Hearts. * '''Mighty Mushroom Rice Balls''':{{Cite|{{Big|Mighty Mushroom Rice Balls}}
Grants a low-level attack-power boost.
The aroma of the mushrooms tickles your nose as you peel back the leafy wrapping.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by using [[Razorshroom]]s or other mighty Ingredients. If eaten, Link will receive a boost to his attack power. * '''Sneaky Mushroom Rice Balls''':{{Cite|{{Big|Sneaky Mushroom Rice Balls}}
Grants a low-level stealth boost.
The aroma of the mushrooms tickles your nose as you peel back the leafy wrapping.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by using [[Silent Shroom]]s or other sneaky Ingredients. Eating them will increase Link's [[Stealth]]. * '''Spicy Mushroom Rice Balls''':{{Cite|{{Big|Spicy Mushroom Rice Balls}}
Grants low-level cold resistance.
The aroma of the mushrooms tickles your nose as you peel back the leafy wrapping.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by using [[Sunshroom]]s or other spicy Ingredients. Link can eat them to gain one level of [[Cold Resistance]]. * '''Tough Mushroom Rice Balls''':{{Cite|{{Big|Tough Mushroom Rice Balls}}
Grants a low-level defense boost.
The aroma of the mushrooms tickles your nose as you peel back the leafy wrapping.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by using [[Ironshroom]]s or other tough Ingredients. When eaten, Link's [[Defense]] will be boosted. ==={{TotK|-}}=== {{Stub|TotK}} ==Other Appearances== ==={{AoC|-}}=== {{Noncanon|Start}} The Recipe for Mushroom Rice Balls is obtained by completing the [[Scenario]] "[[Akkala Tower]]". It is made using two [[Silent Shroom]]s and two [[Hylian Rice]]. Through the completion of the [[Quest]] "[[Hungry Hunches]]", however, the number of each required ingredient can be reduced to one. [[Cooking]] Mushroom Rice Balls before a [[Challenge]] or [[Scenario]] increases the amount of damage dealt with [[Sheikah Rune]]s by fifteen percent. {{Noncanon|End}} ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==Gallery== File:AoC Mushroom Rice Balls Icon.png|{{Game Label|{{AoC|-}}}}Mushroom Rice Balls icon ==See Also== {{See Also| * Food * Meal * Mushroom Risotto }} {{Ref}} {{Categories |Food, Health Restoring Items, Meals, Rice Balls |items= BotW, TotK, AoC }}
